texts.wk_approvals_rule: Ogunyazayo ngamunye oqokiwe uphendula ngokulandelana, hhayi oyithumele. Idokhumenti ebuyiswe ibuyela kothumele.
texts.wk_assist_never: I-LynkAssist ibhala okusalungiswa futhi ichaze. Ayikaze inqume ngokuqasha, iholo, ukukhushulwa, isijeziso noma ukuxoshwa, futhi ayikaze inikeze umuntu amamaki.
texts.wk_assist_summary: I-LynkAssist ingabhala isifinyezo esimakwe njengokusalungiswa. Umphathi oqokiwe ubhala futhi agunyaze ukuhlolwa.
texts.wk_balance: Ikhefu lonyaka elisele: izingxenye zosuku {n} ({entitled} kulo nyaka, {carried} ezidluliselwe, {taken} ezithathiwe).
texts.wk_billed_note: U-{amount} wengezwe kusikweletu ku-LynkInv. Lesi sikhathi ngeke siphinde sikhokhiswe.
texts.wk_board_rule: Umsebenzi uqedwa kuphela uma imisebenzi ewulindile isiqediwe.
texts.wk_cases_hidden: Amacala abonwa kuphela yi-HR nomphenyi oqokiwe.
texts.wk_cases_rule: Isinyathelo ngasinye sinesikhathi esimisiwe. Isinqumo sihlala singesomuntu oqokiwe, kanye nelungelo lokudlulisa.
texts.wk_changes_rule: Isicelo soshintsho samukelwa noma senqatshwe ngumuntu oqokiwe, hhayi lowo osifakile.
texts.wk_checklist_rule: Izimali zokugcina zihamba ziye ku-LynkAcc kuphela ngemuva kwesaziso, ukubuyiswa kwemishini nokuvalwa kokungena. Izinyathelo ozikhethelayo azikaze zivimbe.
texts.wk_clash: Baningi kakhulu abangekho ngo-{days}. Lokhu kuyakhonjiswa, akukaze kwenqatshwe.
texts.wk_correction_note: Isicelo sakho siye ku-HR njengecala. Ungasilandela ku-akhawunti yakho.
texts.wk_expiry_rule: Umuntu ne-HR bakhunjuzwa izinsuku ezingu-60, 30, 7 no-0 ngaphambili. Akukho okuvinjwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
texts.wk_files_rule: Ifayela ngalinye lingaphansi kwerekhodi lalo futhi livuleka kuphela lapho insizakalo yaleyo rekhodi ivumela khona. Akukho okungaphansi kokugcinwa ngokomthetho okushintshayo noma okususwayo.
texts.wk_final_pay_waits: Izimali zokugcina zilinde isaziso, ukubuyiswa kwemishini nokuvalwa kokungena.
texts.wk_guests_rule: Isivakashi sibona kuphela iphrojekthi esimenyelwe kuyo, futhi asikaze sibone imali yayo.
texts.wk_leave_approved_note: Ikhefu ligunyaziwe. Umuntu utshelwa ngolimi lwakhe.
texts.wk_leave_declined_note: Ikhefu lenqatshiwe. Umuntu utshelwa ngolimi lwakhe.
texts.wk_leave_rule: Akekho ophendula isicelo sakhe. Ikhefu libalwa ngezingxenye zosuku.
texts.wk_length: Iphrojekthi ithatha izinsuku {n} endleleni yayo ebalulekile.
texts.wk_not_own_time: Isikhathi sigunyazwa ngumphathi, hhayi lowo osibhalile.
texts.wk_over_shown: Iphrojekthi eyeqe isabelomali iyakhonjiswa, ayikaze ivinjwe.
texts.wk_pay_approved: Kugunyazwe abantu ababili ngaphandle kwalowo ophakamisile.
texts.wk_pay_over_budget: Ukwenyuka kuka-{amount} kweqa isabelomali sika-{budget}, ngakho umuntu wesithathu kufanele agunyaze.
texts.wk_pay_rule: Izimali kuphela. Amaholo enziwa ku-LynkAcc futhi umuntu wesibili uyawabhalisa. Amavolontiya nosonkontileka abakaze babe semaholweni.
texts.wk_payroll_draft: Lezi zimali ziya ku-LynkAcc njengokusalungiswa okubhaliswa ngumuntu wesibili.
texts.wk_people_rule: Uhlobo ngalunye lwesisebenzi lunerekhodi. Amagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kusesisefweni esiyimfihlo.
texts.wk_projects_rule: Izindleko ziya ku-LynkAcc kanti isikhathi esikhokhisiwe siya ku-LynkInv. Inzuzo yilokho okukhokhisiwe kususwe izindleko.
texts.wk_record_pay_hidden: Iholo nemininingwane yasebhange kufihliwe kulo msebenzi.
texts.wk_record_rule: Izinkambu ezibucayi zibonwa yimisebenzi embalwa ngangokunokwenzeka. Imininingwane yezempilo, yomndeni neyenyunyana igcinwa kuphela lapho umthetho uvumela khona. Umuntu uhlala ebona irekhodi lakhe.
texts.wk_requests_rule: Cela othile alayishe idokhumenti erekhodini elifanele. Ungakulandela: kuceliwe, kutholiwe, kuhloliwe.
texts.wk_reviews_rule: Izimpendulo zozakwabo neqembu zikhonjiswa kuphela kusukela kubantu abangu-3, futhi azikaze zibe namagama.
texts.wk_sample_note: Amarekhodi esibonelo okuzama leli khasi. Awakho azovela lapha uma usuqalile ukusebenzisa insizakalo.
texts.wk_sharing_rule: Isixhumanisi ngasinye sokwabelana sinesiphetho. Iphasiwedi igcinwa kuphela ifihliwe.
texts.wk_signing_rule: Wonke umuntu osayinayo usayina inguqulo ayibonile ngqo. Ikhodi yokuqinisekisa ayikaze ikhombise ukuthi ubani osayinile.
texts.wk_time_rule: Isikhathi sisemizuzwini ephelele. Isikhathi esikhokhiswayo esigunyaziwe sikhokhiswa kanye ngo-LynkInv.
texts.wk_timeline_rule: Izinsuku zibalwa kusukela ekuqaleni kwephrojekthi. Imisebenzi esendleleni ebalulekile ihambisa usuku lokuphela.
texts.wk_velocity: I-sprint: amaphuzu angu-{n} aqediwe, kusele angu-{left}.
texts.wk_works_everywhere: Isebenza kunoma yisiphi isiphequluli esingenwe kuso nakuhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Business, ku-inthanethi nangaphandle kwayo.
